evidence_rule: An unexplained variance requires further investigation; it does not, on its own, prove wrongdoing.

evidence_roles.actual: The accounting source confirming the recorded amount
evidence_roles.variance: A record linking the increase or decrease directly to the figure
evidence_roles.context: Helps understand why the cost may have changed, but does not of itself close the figure

baseline_rule: A draft reforecast does not replace the approved baseline unless a formal adjustment is recorded.

aster_rule.text: Items under the same contract and serving the same economic purpose are deemed one economic transaction when limits are applied.

authority_matrix.approval: Chief Financial Officer + Board of Directors

fin_proc_11: Before a commitment: check budget, contract, related items already incurred and total value; escalate if the level changes before proceeding.
Before each disbursement: check invoice, acceptance, contract reference and approval of the original commitment; partial disbursement must not lower the approval level.

fin_alt_02.principle: The alternative route changes only the manner of obtaining a decision. It must not lower the level of authority.

cases.approver_absent: Delegation in force + delegate approves the very transaction
cases.system_interrupted: IT incident code + fallback decision by the person with authority + re-recording when restored
cases.legal_deadline: Specific legal basis + urgent approval by the person with authority

fin_del_18.excludes: Standing in for the CFO or changing the level of authority

control_checklist.A: Same contract + same economic purpose must be judged together
control_checklist.B: Add the related items already incurred to the current item
control_checklist.C: Compare the total value with the FIN-AUTH-05 matrix
control_checklist.D: If the level changes, escalate before the commitment/processing continues

override_conditions: Knowledge of the specific control condition
override_levels_ch4: Grounds to investigate possible management override of controls
A person actively overriding controls identified

control: The record establishes that a checkpoint failed, but does not attribute an active override to a person.
The record raises a credible override concern, but the personal chain of authority, knowledge and action is incomplete.
3 · Active override attributed to an individual
The personal files establish the required chain of authority, specific knowledge and direct action for one individual.
fraud: The present record does not contain enough conduct or conflict evidence to justify a separate fraud investigation.
The present record contains motive and suspicious conduct, but not enough evidence to establish fraud as a concluded fact.
3 · Fraud established on the present record
The present record is sufficient to establish intentional deception and an improper benefit or equivalent fraudulent outcome.

chapter_v_timer_note: Mỗi người có cửa sổ riêng, Victor dùng chung cho hai lời khai. Hết giờ chỉ làm mất điểm lời khai chưa hoàn thành; lời khai đã được chấp nhận giữ kết quả. Tiếp tục bước trách nhiệm. Điều kiện tạm dừng tuân theo mã; phản bác sai không dừng hoặc đặt lại thời gian.

wrong_answer_rule.0_or_1: Tự giải đúng sau 0–1 lỗi mới được mức làm chủ đầy đủ.
wrong_answer_rule.2: Tự giải đúng sau 2 lỗi mới được một nửa mức làm chủ; từ đây áp dụng tạm dừng.
wrong_answer_rule.3_plus: Không còn điểm làm chủ; lần sai thứ ba mở gợi ý.
wrong_answer_rule.gate_release: Mở lại hồ sơ hoặc chờ hết 15 giây.
wrong_answer_rule.repeated_identical_answer: Lỗi cũ đã được ghi bằng mã chữ ký không tự tính thêm; chỉ ghi lỗi mới theo cơ chế từng câu.
wrong_answer_rule.incomplete_sheet: Biểu chưa đủ không được chấm như câu hoàn chỉnh.

scoring.rounding: Cộng điểm từng chương rồi làm tròn điều tra và kỷ luật một chữ số thập phân. Quản trị và tổng cũng làm tròn một chữ số; mức trừ tự thực hiện dùng Math.round.
scoring.hint_deduplication: Chỉ khử trùng theo hintKey khi sự kiện có khóa; không coi mọi sự kiện không khóa là duy nhất.
scoring.calculate_guard: Hàm calculate trực tiếp yêu cầu ba quyết định hợp lệ; điều kiện tiến trình năm chương thuộc luồng giao diện.

people.balanced: Temporarily remove Victor from Northstar decisions, preserve the records and commission an independent investigation before deciding permanent discipline.
people.aggressive: Remove Victor permanently from executive office now, preserve the records and treat the present evidence as sufficient to establish fraud.
people.hesitant: Leave Victor’s authority in place for now, preserve the records and wait for evidence sufficient to prove fraud before imposing any restriction.

northstar.balanced: Suspend new commitments, preserve the records, verify existing deliverables and independently investigate ownership, pricing, services and cash flows.
northstar.aggressive: End all Northstar dealings immediately, preserve the records and withhold remaining payments because the established conflict is sufficient grounds.
northstar.hesitant: Continue Northstar dealings under current terms, preserve the records and postpone an independent investigation until evidence establishes fraud.

system.balanced: Repair aggregation and authority logic, preserve the authority level on fallback routes and add independent review for management exceptions.
system.aggressive: Keep the existing control design largely intact and rely on replacing or disciplining the people involved to prevent recurrence.
system.hesitant: Repair the routing algorithm alone and leave the human checkpoints and fallback-route governance unchanged until another failure occurs.
